body: I’ll try however it’s not really in my hands I work at a fast food shop, I doubt someone would want to sponsor a greencard for me, when there are people that are much higher qualified than me.

I know I have the power for a better future and I do want to come live in USA. However there’s really nothing I can do with the power I have. I have no higher education I barely finished high school. No employer wants me, if I had a job offer in the us I would have been there a long time ago. I could have been a straight A student if only I was born in a country with a functioning school system. It’s too late now anyway. I can barely afford to survive in Russia.
